verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs say its core generation is driven by natural-language prompts (text-to-video, and 'messy or chained prompts work natively'). They also describe Luma Agents that research, generate and refine across multi-step video and image workflows. That points to natural-language operation beyond single prompts, but the evidence is marketing-level: it does not show which product actions agents can actually carry out from conversational commands. Missing for 10: documented detail on the agent command interface and the scope of actions it can perform, and independent hands-on evidence of natural-language operation beyond prompt-to-generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Messy or chained prompts work natively. No middleware or prompt engineering required.
